title: Smiling Family and Friends on Porch, 1940s Deckled Edge B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A cheerful group of young men, women, and a young boy pose closely together on a covered porch or deck. The women wear mid-1940s knee-length dresses, winter coats, and curled hairstyles, while the men wear fedora hats and collared shirts. The boy in the center is dressed in denim overalls beneath a heavy plaid wool coat. In the sunlit background to the right, a domestic dog walks along the edge of the railed porch. The photograph features deckled edges, characteristic of mid-20th-century family snapshots.
